# Luis Michael Goyone

> Software engineer based in the Philippines, working remotely, with 4+ years of experience building web applications in React and TypeScript. I build web products, and the AI agent workflows that ship them.

## Roles

- Software Engineer (Part-time) at Chief (formerly Storytell), https://chief.bot — Jun 2026 to present. Chief is an AI meeting assistant that transcribes meetings, summarizes them, and acts on them across tools like Notion, Slack, GitHub, and Linear. I designed and run my own Claude Code pipeline (planner, coder and tester subagents, plus slash commands and skills for scoping, review, browser verification, video proof and review follow-up) that takes Linear tickets to review-ready pull requests across the web app, native desktop app, shared TypeScript libraries, and Go backend. Every UI change is verified in a real browser with Playwright and recorded as video. I also built native iOS (SwiftUI) and Android (Jetpack Compose) versions of the desktop app. Agents draft the code; I own scope, review, and what ships. In my first three months I merged 149 pull requests, 25% of the engineering team's human-authored merges.
- Software Engineer at 24metrics — Mar 2025 to present. Ad fraud protection platform. I build the React and TypeScript front end from Figma, ship some Go API changes, and led our last site launch. I built my own Cursor setup: an /execute-ticket skill that takes a Linear ticket to a draft PR with screenshots, a developer agent whose rules come from real review comments, and a skill that renders documentation screenshots from the real UI with fictional data. Claude Code is my second reviewer and Playwright tester.
- Software Engineer at Booky — Aug 2022 to Feb 2025. Deals and discoveries platform serving millions of users across the Philippines; React and TypeScript features across multiple products.
- Software Engineer at PouchNation — Jan 2022 to May 2022. Cashless and guest management platform for venues and events.

## Skills

- AI engineering: Claude Code (subagents, skills, slash commands), Cursor (skills, agents, rules), multi-agent workflows, MCP integrations, prompt engineering, AI-assisted code review
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, HTML & CSS, Java, Python, SQL
- Frameworks and libraries: React, Next.js, SolidJS, React Native, Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, Shadcn/ui, Vite
- Tools: Git, Playwright, PostgreSQL, Docker, Figma

## Education

- Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Cum Laude — Saint Louis University (2018–2022)
